quizName:
Hardest Questions in New jersey
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yellow light, and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: When must you stop your vehicle while driving?

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
When a red light is on.
When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a stop sign, at a red light, or whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right of way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: When may the MVC cancel your road test before it starts?

options.text: The center console blocks the examiner's access to the brake pedal.
Your vehicle is missing seat belts.

questions.explanation: The test may be canceled before it starts if the examiner thinks your vehicle is unsafe. The vehicle may be unsafe if it is missing seat belts or if the examiner cannot reach the foot brake or parking brake.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is driving aggressively behind you?

options.text: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Stare at the driver as they pass you.
Speed up as they are passing you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: If someone is driving aggressively, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Do not speed up or challenge them, as this will make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to be careful when it rains. Wet pavement can be slippery and make your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm extended?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Continue driving when you think the children are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not move until the arm is withdrawn.

questions.question: What must you do when turning or changing lanes?

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
Signal only if you see other traffic.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
questions.explanation: Always use your signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from the curb. Do not skip this step even if you do not see other cars.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm when another driver is being dangerous. Put distance between your car and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not look at them or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs show railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a train crossing is coming. Look for signs of an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show?
questions.explanation: You must always have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your car. You must show all three documents when stopped by police.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that makes you take your eyes off the road, your hands off the wheel, or your attention away from driving.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry because all cars are the same.
Hide from your friend that you do not know the car.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where everything is and how to operate it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where everything is and how to operate it.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, spend a few minutes learning where the turn signals, headlights, wipers, brakes, and horn are located. Make sure you know how to use them. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. Where this sign is posted, you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to let oncoming traffic go first. You can turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You are on a freeway and miss your exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Keep driving until you reach the next exit or place where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you reach the next exit or place where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Continue to the next exit or safe place to turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your brain, making you less cautious and more reckless. It slows your reactions, worsens your coordination and balance, and impairs your vision and judgment of distance.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol harm your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: What can impair your ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness all make driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At railroad tracks, look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop if a train or vehicle is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle and move it off the road if possible. Check if anyone is hurt. Call 911 if someone is injured. You must report the crash to police if someone is hurt, someone dies, or damage is more than $1,000 (or more than $200 to government property like signs).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: You are angry after something bad happened at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait to calm down before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: Night driving is harder than daytime driving because:

options.text: You cannot see as well in the dark.
It rains more often at night.
You see more motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as well in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far. Always use your headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. Any extra task can distract you from driving safely.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: Before driving, remove snow and ice from:
questions.explanation: State law requires you to remove all snow and ice from your vehicle before driving. You may be fined if you do not follow this law.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: When driving on major highways:

options.text: Be ready to react to road hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready to react to unexpected hazards. Keep your eyes moving to avoid highway hypnosis. Do not look at any one thing for more than a few seconds.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the freeway, you should:

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back your car to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for an escort back to your exit.

questions.explanation: Take the next exit if you miss yours. Do not stop, back up, or cross the median on the highway. Do not swerve across lanes at the last second. These actions are illegal and dangerous.
